utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Good afternoon. Good afternoon ladies and gentlemen. Madam Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is case number IT-05-87-A, the Prosecutor versus Sainovic et al.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. May I now please have the appearances of the parties. For the Prosecution first.

utterances.speaker: MS. VERRALL
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. For the Prosecution my name is Saeeda Verrall, together with Laurel Baig and our Case Manager Colin Nawrot.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. And for the appellants, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Mr. President. I am attorney Toma Fila, and I am defending Nikola Sainovic, thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. VISNJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Attorney Tomislav Visnjic, defending General Ojdanic.

utterances.speaker: MR. ALEKSIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Aleksander Aleksic on behalf of General Nebojsa Pavkovic's Defence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. CEPIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. I'm Djuro Cepic and today I represent Defence team of General Vladimir Lazarevic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. IVETIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Dan Ivetic along with lead counsel Branko Lukic, appearing on behalf of Mr. Sreten Lukic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Before we start, I would like to know whether all the parties can hear the proceedings in a language that they understand. Mr. Sainovic. THE APPELLANT SAINOVIC: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Mr. Ojdanic. THE APPELLANT OJDANIC: [Interpretation] I can hear.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Mr. Pavkovic. THE APPELLANT PAVKOVIC: [Interpretation] I can hear everything well.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Mr. Lazarevic. THE APPELLANT LAZAREVIC: [Interpretation] Everything is fine.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Mr. Lukic. THE APPELLANT LUKIC: [Interpretation] Yes, I understand.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. This Status Conference is called in accordance with Rule 65 bis (B) of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence of the Tribunal, which requires a Status Conference to be convened every 120 days during the appeal proceedings to allow that any person in custody pending appeal the opportunity to raise issues in relation thereto, including the mental and physical condition of that person. In the present case, the last Status Conference was held on the 17th May 2011. Today's Status Conference was scheduled by order issued on the 30th June 2011. First, I would like to inquire into the status of the detention conditions and the health situation of all the appellants. If you have any concerns in relation to the detention condition or your state of health that cannot be resolved through the standard procedures, I would invite you to raise them now. If you wish, the discussion can take place in private session. Yes. Are there any issues that the parties would like to raise? Well, it seems to me there is none, which is a surprise to me. Now I will recall the recent procedural history of this case. Before we turn to any issues that parties may wish to raise, I would like to briefly note a few recent procedural matters. At the last Status Conference, I indicated that the deadline for any party wishing to file a motion to vary their grounds of appeal following the translation of the trial judgement into B/C/S would expire on the 14th of June, 2011. Mr. Lukic was the only party to file such motion within the prescribed time limit. On the 9th September 2011, the Appeals Chamber dismissed his re-filed motion requesting leave to vary his notice of appeal and the appeal brief. Accordingly, the translation of the trial judgement into B/C/S will no longer constitute good cause for any party seeking to vary their grounds of appeal under Rule 108 of the Rules. There are currently no pending motions in the present case. At this point, I would like to ask the parties whether they have any other issues that they would like to raise at this time. Are there any other issues the Prosecution would like to raise?

utterances.speaker: MS. VERRALL
utterances.text: There are no issues on behalf of the Prosecution, Your Honour. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Now I turn to counsel for Mr. Sainovic. Do you have any other issues that you would like to raise?

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: No. No, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Thank you very much. Counsel for Mr. Ojdanic.

utterances.speaker: MR. VISNJIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, we have no special issues.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Counsel for Mr. Pavkovic.

utterances.speaker: MR. ALEKSIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, Your Honour. At the moment, we have no issues.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Counsel for Mr. Lazarevic.

utterances.speaker: MR. CEPIC
utterances.text: At this moment nothing to raise, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Counsel for Mr. Lukic.

utterances.speaker: MR. IVETIC
utterances.text: Your Honour, we have nothing now to raise on behalf of the Lukic Defence. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, I believe that is the shortest Status Conference in this Tribunal. This concludes today's Status Conference. I thank the parties for their attendance and adjourn the proceedings.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 2.39 p.m.
